why: I'm calling this one contested. Outdoor Life is a major reviewer that field-tested solar generators and names a camping kit pick (Bluetti AC60 + PV120). It's a general guide, though, and doesn't focus on weekend tent camping. None of the other sources is a tested major reviewer or an official source. They're niche spec or price-tracking sites (Portable Power Authority, powersized, SolutionEnergy) and affiliate listicles, some on recycled domains, with testing claims nobody can check. That leaves room for a focused weekend-camping kit page with current prices and codes, but it would compete with Outdoor Life's tested pick.
